root.label: Friedkin Group explores sale of Everton

events.label: Friedkin Group explores sale of Everton

slots.name: sale status
slots.sentence: Premier League club Everton is on the market again after U.S. owner the Friedkin Group announced on Friday it was exploring investment options and a potential sale.

slots.name: English titles
slots.sentence: The announcement placed fresh uncertainty over the nine-time English champion and founding member of the Premier League.

slots.name: ownership duration
slots.sentence: “I was surprised because they only came in a year and a half ago. Most owners come in a lot longer than that,” Moyes said.
